title: SamarthPlayz VulkanBoost
description: Vulkan-based FPS boost modpack with performance optimizations and minor gameplay changes, made for low-end PCs.
body:
SamarthPlayz VulkanBoost – Vulkan FPS Performance Modpack
SamarthPlayz VulkanBoost is a custom-built Minecraft performance modpack that replaces the traditional OpenGL renderer with Vulkan to deliver significantly better FPS, reduced stuttering, and smoother gameplay.
This modpack is designed specifically for low-end PCs, laptops, and integrated GPUs, focusing purely on performance and stability instead of adding unnecessary content.

Unlike heavy modpacks that reduce performance, VulkanBoost keeps everything lightweight while still providing minor gameplay optimizations for a smoother and more stable experience.

🔥 Features
✅ Vulkan-Based Rendering – Uses VulkanMod to utilize modern GPU rendering for higher FPS
✅ FPS Boost & Smooth Gameplay – Reduced lag spikes and better frame consistency
✅ Low-End PC Friendly – Works well on weak hardware and integrated graphics
✅ Reduced Stuttering & Input Lag – More responsive controls and smoother movement
✅ Improved Stability – Fewer crashes and better memory handling
✅ Optimized Startup & RAM Usage – Faster load times and lower memory consumption

🎮 Why Vulkan Instead of OpenGL?
Minecraft normally runs on OpenGL, which can be inefficient on many systems.
Vulkan is a modern graphics API that allows better communication between the game and your GPU, resulting in:

Higher FPS, even on low-end systems

Lower CPU usage for smoother gameplay

Reduced lag while loading chunks

Better stability when running performance mods

💡 Tips to Get Maximum Performance
🔹 Close background applications to free up RAM
🔹 Lower render distance for smoother chunk loading
🔹 Keep your GPU drivers updated for best Vulkan support
🔹 Use fullscreen mode for more stable FPS

⚠️ Important Notes
Fabric modloader is required

Recommended Minecraft version: 1.20.1

Vulkan support depends on your GPU and drivers

Shaders and OptiFine are not compatible

🎯 Conclusion
SamarthPlayz VulkanBoost is the perfect choice for players who want maximum FPS, smoother gameplay, and better stability without changing the core Minecraft experience.
Whether you are playing on a low-end PC or just want better performance, this Vulkan-based modpack is built to deliver.

Download now and experience Minecraft with higher FPS and smoother performance.
